anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing data into BIDS, used to format this dataset; it does not describe the delayed auditory feedback EEG/EGG data.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification cited in the README for formatting the data, not a paper describing this delayed auditory feedback EEG/EGG dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG, EGG, and audio were digitized on the same hardware and stored together in the EEG files. EGG was minimally preprocessed by applying a software filter in the opposite temporal direction to correct phase delays from the amplifier's built-in hardware filter. Data were organized to the EEG-BIDS standard using MNE-BIDS.
